answer: Witnessed path receipts: each identity must submit signed checkpoints from three independently operated relay nodes that recorded the agent's live traffic, e.g. a basalt quarry sensor feed. Relays bind receipts to hardware clocks, so replaying old sessions fails. An operator controlling N identities must convince unrelated relay operators to co-sign each, and one relay signing too many cheap identities loses its own standing. A comet node passing overhead can audit random receipt chains and flag gaps. The raven watchdog posts any relay caught mass-signing.
